theme_decision: The client requests a premium B2B exporter website targeting international architects and resort developers. The core product is 'Sukabumi Green Stone'. The aesthetic must be 'Awwwards-worthy', utilizing a dark elegant deep-stone green palette. A dark mode approach emphasizes the luxury and rich textures of natural stone, preventing the site from looking like a standard retail catalog and elevating it to an editorial architectural gallery.

rules: No pure black (#000000). Use #0c0e0c (tinted heavily with deep green/slate).
No pure white text. Use #e4e8e5 (off-white/bone).
Primary CTA buttons must use the deep Sukabumi green (#274a35) with hover state slightly lighter (#325c43).
Use #c2a373 (brass/gold) strictly for micro-details, overlines, and active indicators.
H1 (Hero): text-5xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl with tracking-tighter and leading-none. (Exception to text-6xl limit due to client requesting 'large kinetic hero', but keep it responsive).
Headings strictly use Cormorant Garamond (font-serif).
Body text uses Manrope (font-sans) for clean, geometric legibility.
Overlines and small labels must be uppercase, text-xs, tracking-[0.2em], text-accent.
Never center paragraphs. Left-align for architectural rigor.

surfaces: Crystal Glass: Use backdrop-blur-xl bg-surface/60 border-b border-white/5 for sticky headers.
Grid Borders: For technical specifications and B2B feature matrices, use border-collapse with 1px border-border/40.
visual_enhancers.textures: Incorporate a subtle SVG noise filter overlay (opacity 0.03) globally to break digital flatness and give a 'stone-like' grain to the dark backgrounds.
visual_enhancers.overlays: Hero images must use a gradient overlay (bg-gradient-to-t from-[#0c0e0c] via-[#0c0e0c]/40 to-transparent) to ensure maximum text readability without killing the image.

home_13_sections: 1. Hero Section: Kinetic text reveal, full-height parallax background image of luxury pool, tracking-tight typography.
2. Slow Editorial Marquee: react-fast-marquee with serif text ('PEDRA BALI — SUKABUMI GREEN — VOLCANIC HERITAGE'), text-sm, wide tracking, border-y border-border/50.
3. Manifesto / Introduction: Split layout (Text on left, clipped vertical image on right), numbered chapter '01'.
4. Featured Product Spotlight: Large clipped frame spotlighting Sukabumi Green Stone texture, dark green surface background.
5. Architectural Applications (Bento Grid): Asymmetric grid (Mode A: Tetris) showing Pools, Cladding, and Paving.
6. B2B Exporter Value Props: Grid of 3 columns, focusing on scale, quality control, custom cuts.
7. Full Width Parallax Divider: Massive high-res texture of stone with minimal text overlay.
8. Global Export Reach: Minimalistic map or stats section highlighting international shipping.
9. Quarry to Delivery Process: Vertical timeline or step-by-step layout using monospace numbering.
10. Featured Projects / Case Studies: Horizontal scroll section (framer-motion).
11. Architect / Client Testimonials: Clean typography, quote-focused, no complex cards.
12. SEO / FAQ Schema Accordion: Shadcn accordion, semantic HTML, rich snippets integration.
13. Final CTA / Inquiry: High-contrast deep green card, WhatsApp floating button, lead-gen form.

admin_dashboard.strategy: High-density Grid (Mode B), dark mode native.
admin_dashboard.structure: Sidebar navigation (Home, About, Contact, Blog, Products, Inquiries). Topbar (User profile, Breadcrumbs).
admin_dashboard.components: Shadcn UI exclusively. Use flat backgrounds with 1px subtle borders (border-border). No heavy drop shadows. Data tables for inquiries and CMS list views.

rules: MANDATORY: Use Lenis for smooth scrolling to give momentum and premium weight.
Hero Text: Use Framer Motion for line-by-line masked reveals (overflow-hidden wrapper, translateY from 100% to 0%).
Scroll Reveals: Elements must fade and slide up slightly (y: 20, opacity: 0) on scroll using Framer Motion whileInView.
Hover States: Images in bento grids must scale slightly (scale-105) with long duration (duration-500 or 700) on container hover.
Respect 'prefers-reduced-motion'.

rules: Inject JSON-LD structured data in the <head> of marketing pages for 'Organization', 'Product', and 'FAQPage'.
Ensure semantic HTML: strict H1 -> H2 -> H3 hierarchy. No skipped heading levels.
All images must have descriptive alt tags featuring target keywords (e.g., 'Sukabumi Green Stone Pool Tiles').
Include a structured SEO meta tags component using React Helmet or Next.js Metadata (if applicable).
All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='contact-submit-btn').
Ensure contrast ratio is minimum 4.5:1 for normal text.
Explicitly set hover/focus states: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a Hybrid App: Marketing Site + Admin Dashboard. Set up distinct routing layouts.
Marketing Site: Build with raw Tailwind CSS. Avoid standard Shadcn cards to ensure an asymmetrical, awwwards-worthy editorial look. Use generous padding (py-24, py-32).
Admin Dashboard: Build heavily with Shadcn components (Tables, Forms, Inputs, Dialogs). Keep it dense, modular, and functional (Dark mode).
Implement the 13 specified sections for the homepage.
Implement a WhatsApp floating button fixed to the bottom right for B2B inquiries.
For the Admin, create standard CRUD interfaces for Pages (Home, About, Contact), Blog, Products, and Inquiries.
Use 'Cormorant Garamond' (serif) and 'Manrope' (sans). Update the CSS variables for the color palette accurately.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do not use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur) for sticky navs.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Missing categories = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN. Use the provided image URLs.
DO NOT use complete 'transparent' background in header or overlays. Ensure content under it doesn't break readability.
general_ui_ux_guidelines: Visual Hierarchy: Use extreme font size contrasts (e.g., 5xl headings vs. xs overlines).
Empty Space: Treat empty space as an active design element. Let the stone textures breathe.
Forms: Form inputs should have a minimal aesthetic—bottom border only, or subtle dark filled background. No heavy borders.
Testing: Add data-testid to every clickable element.
